summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 66 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: A.I. Start-Ups From Canada and Germany Merge to Take On Silicon Valley
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New Phishing Scam: Fake Invitations
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
